hypotheses: A cfg(test)-only failure injected immediately after a real partial write+sync in BoundedCurrentV2::advance leaves the same current fileID poisoned and the already-created next phase intact.
No retry, rollback, phase removal or completion/catch-up can use that old prefix; decoding/opening the partial pointer is Required/unknown and never Closed.
The default production write path and absolute deadline stay unchanged; this test does not fabricate an OS permission failure or any OriginalSession authority.
scope: two actual bounded-v2 current tests only; unaffected tree and projection tests reused
